candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all common evidence, creates one complete executable closure, locks public-contract conformance, and delegates revocable behavioral authority. The terminal call consumes that closure and public non-anchor evidence, applies the irreversible preservation-only transition when the causal contradiction trigger is present, and emits the lineage's single policy.

candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one contract-locked executable handoff carrying revocable behavioral authority

calls.objective: Form one complete executable policy closure from the supplied evidence, bind public-contract conformance immutably, and pass behavior-semantic authority forward in a revision-enabled but causally revocable state.

Consume initialize_revocable_closure and the supplied public evidence, preserve locked contract conformance, irreversibly withdraw behavioral-revision authority when the stated causal contradiction is present, and emit one complete policy from the resulting authority state.

mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion has fixed authority boundaries but no mechanism for evidence to withdraw already delegated behavioral authority.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: This introduces dynamic evidence-controlled authority revocation absent from the champion and tested static visibility, provenance, materialization, and authority-boundary factors.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: When the trigger occurs, the single inherited complete artifact is emitted without behavioral alteration; otherwise the same lineage retains contract-bounded behavioral authority.
mode_certificate.state_transition: The terminal call irreversibly transitions from revision-enabled authority to preservation-only authority, immediately losing permission to alter the inherited behavior-bearing semantics.
mode_certificate.trigger: Before behavioral alteration, candidate_hypothesis requires a causal relationship that loop_structure explicitly denies under task_constraints.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Make terminal behavioral authority revocable through an irreversible evidence-triggered transition from revision-enabled to preservation-only authority.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Unsupported behavioral displacement should be suppressed while causally coherent behavioral revision remains available.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion delegates static terminal behavioral authority that remains available even when public evidence defeats the causal premise for changing the inherited artifact.

structural_mutation.after: The handoff grants revocable behavioral authority that irreversibly becomes preservation-only when public evidence contradicts the proposed causal premise.
structural_mutation.before: The contract-locked handoff grants the terminal call fixed authority to revise behavior-bearing semantics.
structural_mutation.factor: contradiction-triggered irreversible revocation of terminal behavioral-revision authority
